method_scope: Bounded, STPA-informed supervisor analysis; not a complete system-level STPA and not independently reviewed.
analysis_system_boundary: Conceptual outdoor UAV mission system comprising the operator/supervisory station, autonomy stack, runtime assurance supervisor, flight controller, vehicle, sensing, and environment.
implemented_component_boundary: Only the telemetry-driven runtime assurance supervisor and deterministic replay harness are implemented. Upstream telemetry validity, command delivery, vehicle dynamics, fallback execution, and environmental response are outside the code boundary.

losses.description: People, property, or the vehicle are harmed by a collision.
The vehicle leaves the declared operational envelope or cannot be recovered.
Critical mission objectives or irreplaceable mission data are lost through an unrecoverable vehicle or mission state.

hazards.description: Vehicle speed and obstacle separation leave insufficient modeled distance to stop before the protected clearance boundary.
Autonomous control relies on localization or perception evidence whose confidence, freshness, or cross-modal consistency is inadequate for the declared context.
The mission remains in a supervisory mode requiring a fresh communication link while link-age evidence exceeds the declared bound.
Autonomous continuation requires a fallback path, but the fallback-availability input reports that no such path is available.

components.role: mission, perception, state-estimation, and navigation stack
runtime evidence evaluator and fallback recommender

unsafe_control_actions.context: the modeled stopping-margin failure condition has persisted through the configured window and M-OBS-MARGIN is latched FAIL
unsafe_control_actions.description: CONTINUE is recommended after the persistence-qualified stopping-margin condition has failed.

unsafe_control_actions.context: a localization, LiDAR-freshness, or cross-modal failure condition has persisted through the configured window and its monitor is latched FAIL
unsafe_control_actions.description: CONTINUE is recommended while persistence-qualified state/perception evidence lacks support.

unsafe_control_actions.context: communication age has remained beyond the failure bound through the configured window and M-COMM-FRESH is latched FAIL
unsafe_control_actions.description: CONTINUE remains recommended after persistence-qualified supervisory-link evidence has failed.

unsafe_control_actions.context: fallback availability has remained false or missing through the configured window and M-FALLBACK is latched FAIL
unsafe_control_actions.description: CONTINUE remains recommended after persistence-qualified fallback-availability evidence has failed.

safety_constraints.description: The supervisor shall not recommend CONTINUE after the stopping-margin monitor has latched failure.
The supervisor shall not recommend CONTINUE after localization, LiDAR-freshness, or cross-modal evidence has latched failure.
The supervisor shall not recommend CONTINUE after communication-freshness evidence has latched failure.
The supervisor shall not recommend CONTINUE after M-FALLBACK has latched failure.

causal_scenarios.description: Obstacle range falls while speed remains high, but delayed range feedback or an optimistic stopping-model parameter prevents the supervisor from latching the margin failure.
A LiDAR timestamp freezes while plausible measurements are reused and the age field is not advanced or is parsed incorrectly.
Camera and LiDAR observations diverge, but a poorly calibrated consistency score remains above the failure band.
The link heartbeat stops, but a frozen or misinterpreted timestamp suppresses the communication-age failure.
A stale or misparsed fallback flag remains true, or a persistence/action-priority defect suppresses ABORT after fallback loss.
